174: Rabbi Elazar said: And it was after these things, what is that? Behold, it has been established as the place from which the evil impulse accuses. For that is the level of, "after these things." It was because Joseph gave it a place from which to accuse, as Joseph was curling his hair, and grooming and adorning himself. So he gave the evil impulse a place from which to accuse. As it said, "How is it that his father is mourning for him, yet he is adorning himself and curling his hair?" So the bear was made to harass him, and it accused him.
